g.text: Each run sheet is one dynamic-array formula in A5 that turns Planned Total into one printed row per mix.

rect.data-description: LOOKUP (other sheet or table). A2 =TODAY(). H2 ='Mix-Slice-Oven'!O2 = 180 bags.
INPUT (typed). Typed 6:45. Printed only; no finish times follow from it.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Filters MCS LINE runs with Planned above 0, sorts by placement, expands one row per mix, then adds Changeover rows. Outputs run, bags, bags per mix, minutes. =LET(ud,Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],pt,IFERROR(--Mix_Slice_Oven[Planned Total],0),as,Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset],keep,FILTER(ud,(pt>0)*(ud<>"")*(as="MCS LINE"),""),u,UNIQUE(keep),x,XLOOKUP(u,UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Placement On Scedule],""),p,IF(x="",9999,IFERROR(--x,9999)),s,SORTBY(u,p),ps,SORTBY(p,p),tot,SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[Planned Total],Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],s),bpm,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(s,UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Optimal Bag],""),0),tm,XLOOKUP(s,UniqueDough[Dough],UniqueDough[Optimal Time],""),k,IF(bpm>0,ROUNDUP(tot/bpm,0),1),n,SUM(k),cum,SCAN(0,k,LAMBDA(a,v,a+v)),r,SEQUENCE(n),idx,MAP(r,LAMBDA(v,XMATCH(v,cum,1))),st,MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(s,v))),tt,MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(tot,v))),bb,MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(bpm,v))),mm,MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(tm,v))),ord,MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(ps,v))),dg,UniqueDough[Dough],upl,UniqueDough[Placement On Scedule],utm,UniqueDough[Optimal Time],rr,SEQUENCE(ROWS(dg)),ci,FILTER(rr,dg="Changeover",0),co_ord,MAP(ci,LAMBDA(v,IF(v=0,0,IFERROR(--INDEX(upl,v-1),0)+0.5))),co_tm,MAP(ci,LAMBDA(v,IF(v=0,0,IFERROR(--INDEX(utm,v),0)))),co_nm,MAP(ci,LAMBDA(v,IF(v=0,"",INDEX(dg,v)))),okco,(co_ord>MIN(ord))*(co_ord<MAX(ord)),allrows,VSTACK(HSTACK(st,tt,bb,mm),HSTACK(co_nm,0*ci,0*ci,co_tm)),allkeys,VSTACK(ord,co_ord),flt,VSTACK(0*ord+1,okco),SORTBY(FILTER(allrows,flt=1),FILTER(allkeys,flt=1)))
FORMULA (this sheet). k = ROUNDUP(run bags / Optimal Bag), or 1 if the run has no Optimal Bag. SCAN builds the running count so each mix gets its own row.
FORMULA (this sheet). Every Unique Dough row named Changeover is placed at the placement of the row above it + 0.5, and kept only if it falls between today's first and last run.

FORMULA (this sheet). Per run: bags mixed, raw DSD bags, raw DIST bags. =LET(a,CHOOSECOLS(ANCHORARRAY(A5),1),c,CHOOSECOLS(ANCHORARRAY(A5),3),u,UNIQUE(a),sk,Mix_Slice_Oven[Sku],dw,IFERROR(--Mix_Slice_Oven[Dough Weight],0),ud,Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],g,XLOOKUP(sk,Products[No.],Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],""),HSTACK(u,MAP(u,LAMBDA(v,SUM((a=v)*c))),MAP(u,LAMBDA(v,SUM((ud=v)*(g="FG")*dw))),MAP(u,LAMBDA(v,SUM((ud=v)*(g="FG-DIST")*dw)))))

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =LET(p,Oven_Info[Pans],nm,Oven_Info[Finished Product],n,IFERROR(--Oven_Info['# of Pans/Boxes to set out],0),nx,DROP(VSTACK(p,""),1),FILTER(HSTACK(nm,n),(p="Pan")*(nx="MCS LINE")*(n>0),"No MCS pans"))
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). From Critical Lookup Information, not Unique Dough. N5 =XLOOKUP($A5,'Critical Lookup Information'!$D:$D,'Critical Lookup Information'!$E:$E).

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). =IFS(C4=1,XLOOKUP($A4,'Critical Lookup Information'!$D:$D,'Critical Lookup Information'!$J:$J),C4=2,XLOOKUP($A4,'Critical Lookup Information'!$D:$D,'Critical Lookup Information'!$I:$I),C4=3,XLOOKUP($A4,'Critical Lookup Information'!$D:$D,'Critical Lookup Information'!$H:$H),C4=4,XLOOKUP($A4,'Critical Lookup Information'!$D:$D,'Critical Lookup Information'!$G:$G),C4=1.5,XLOOKUP($A4,'Critical Lookup Information'!$D:$D,'Critical Lookup Information'!$K:$K),C4=0,"0") Returns #N/A today.
NOTE. 47 mixes + 2 changeovers, 180 bags, 17.25 h.
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). A2 =TODAY(). H2 ='Mix-Slice-Oven'!O1 = 54.5 bags.
INPUT (typed). Typed 7:50. Printed only.

LOOKUP (other sheet or table). Breadline and Breadline/Artisan runs with Planned above 0. =LET(ud,Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],pt,IFERROR(--Mix_Slice_Oven[Planned Total],0),as,Mix_Slice_Oven[Asset],keep,FILTER(ud,(pt>0)*(ud<>"")*((as="Breadline")+(as="Breadline/Artisan")),""),u,UNIQUE(keep),dnm,UniqueDough[Dough],ob,UniqueDough[Optimal Bag],ot,UniqueDough[Optimal Time],pl,UniqueDough[Placement On Scedule],mk,ISNUMBER(SEARCH("Marble",u)),nu,FILTER(u,NOT(mk),""),nt,IF(nu="",0,SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[Planned Total],Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],nu)),nb,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(nu,dnm,ob,""),0),ntm,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(nu,dnm,ot,""),0),nk,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(nu,dnm,pl,""),9999),mu,FILTER(u,mk,""),sfx,IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("Pullman",mu)),"Pullman","Hearth"),pnm,IF(mu="","","Pump for Marble "&sfx),rnm,IF(mu="","","Rye for Marble "&sfx),mt,IF(mu="",0,SUMIFS(Mix_Slice_Oven[Planned Total],Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],mu)),pb,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(pnm,dnm,ob,1),1),rb,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(rnm,dnm,ob,1.5),1.5),ptm,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(pnm,dnm,ot,0),0),rtm,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(rnm,dnm,ot,0),0),pk,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(pnm,dnm,pl,""),9999),rk,IFERROR(--XLOOKUP(rnm,dnm,pl,""),9999),sets,IF(mu="",0,ROUNDUP(mt/(pb+rb),0)),anm,VSTACK(nu,pnm,rnm),ato,VSTACK(nt,sets*pb,sets*rb),abp,VSTACK(nb,pb,rb),atm,VSTACK(ntm,ptm,rtm),aky,VSTACK(nk,pk,rk),ok,anm<>"",fnm,FILTER(anm,ok),fto,FILTER(ato,ok),fbp,FILTER(abp,ok),ftm,FILTER(atm,ok),fky,FILTER(aky,ok),s,SORTBY(fnm,fky),tot,SORTBY(fto,fky),bpm,SORTBY(fbp,fky),tm,SORTBY(ftm,fky),k,IF(bpm>0,ROUNDUP(tot/bpm,0),1),n,SUM(k),cum,SCAN(0,k,LAMBDA(a,v,a+v)),r,SEQUENCE(n),idx,MAP(r,LAMBDA(v,XMATCH(v,cum,1))),nm,MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(s,v))),occ,MAP(r,LAMBDA(v,LET(i,INDEX(idx,v),v-INDEX(cum,i)+INDEX(k,i)))),mg,IF(ISNUMBER(SEARCH("for Marble",nm)),TRIM(MID(nm,SEARCH("for Marble",nm)+10,50)),""),gk,MAP(r,LAMBDA(v,LET(m,INDEX(mg,v),IF(m="",INDEX(idx,v),MIN(FILTER(idx,mg=m)))))),oc,IF(mg="",0,occ),out,HSTACK(nm,MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(tot,v))),MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(bpm,v))),MAP(idx,LAMBDA(v,INDEX(tm,v)))),SORTBY(out,gk,1,oc,1,idx,1))
FORMULA (this sheet). A Marble run becomes sets of Pump for Marble (1 bag) and Rye for Marble (1.5 bags): sets = ROUNDUP(Marble bags / 2.5). Rows are interleaved Pump, Rye, Pump, Rye.

FORMULA (this sheet). Same as MCS F5, one column to the right. =LET(a,CHOOSECOLS(ANCHORARRAY(A5),1),c,CHOOSECOLS(ANCHORARRAY(A5),3),u,UNIQUE(a),sk,Mix_Slice_Oven[Sku],dw,IFERROR(--Mix_Slice_Oven[Dough Weight],0),ud,Mix_Slice_Oven[Unique Dough],g,XLOOKUP(sk,Products[No.],Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],""),HSTACK(u,MAP(u,LAMBDA(v,SUM((a=v)*c))),MAP(u,LAMBDA(v,SUM((ud=v)*(g="FG")*dw))),MAP(u,LAMBDA(v,SUM((ud=v)*(g="FG-DIST")*dw)))))
LOOKUP (other sheet or table). From Critical Lookup Information. N5 =XLOOKUP(A5,'Critical Lookup Information'!D:D,'Critical Lookup Information'!E:E).
NOTE. 25 mixes, 54.5 bags, 9.92 h.
NOTE. Filter: MCS LINE vs Breadline + Breadline/Artisan. MCS inserts Changeover rows; Breadline splits Marble. MCS lists pans to set out (F29); Breadline does not. Bag Count sits in F5 vs G5.
ISSUE. E4 is a typed start. Nothing adds run minutes to it, so every later time is written by hand.

rect.data-title: Bag Count spills over the form
rect.data-description: ISSUE. The F5/G5 summary lands on the Time Start, Time Finish, Temp and Operator columns.
ISSUE. Gaps, an off-by-one on row 7 and #REF! on row 10: 711 #N/A in total.
ISSUE. Both sheets' Print_Area names point at deleted ranges.
ISSUE. Runs share placements 48, 50 and 53, so their order on the sheet is arbitrary.

rect.data-title: Attributes come from the second copy
rect.data-description: ISSUE. N:S and D4 read Critical Lookup Information, so Unique Dough edits never print.

flowchart TD classDef input fill:#B3E65F,stroke:#6E9A24,color:#2F440B classDef export fill:#B8ACFB,stroke:#8A7BE0,color:#231266 classDef calc fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef lookup fill:#FFB575,stroke:#CC7830,color:#542700 classDef output fill:#DDDDD8,stroke:#8A8A7E,color:#434339 classDef issue fill:#FFC6C6,stroke:#BD0A0A,color:#5C0A0A MSO["Mix_Slice_Oven
Planned Total, Asset, Unique Dough"]:::lookup UD["Unique Dough
Placement, Optimal Bag, Optimal Time"]:::input S1["1 Keep runs with Planned above 0
on this line"]:::calc MB["Breadline only: Marble becomes
Pump 1 bag + Rye 1.5 bag sets"]:::calc S2["2 Sort by Placement On Scedule"]:::calc S3["3 Mixes per run =
ROUNDUP(bags / bags per mix)"]:::calc S4["4 SCAN running count
one row per mix"]:::calc CO["MCS only: add Changeover rows
at placement above + 0.5"]:::calc IL["Breadline only: interleave
Pump, Rye, Pump, Rye"]:::calc MCS["MCS Schedule A5:D
47 mixes + 2 changeovers"]:::output BL["Breadline Schedule A5:D
25 mixes"]:::output CLI["Critical Lookup Information
D:O notes, attributes, run times"]:::input ATT["N:S attributes and notes"]:::lookup BC["F5 / G5 Bag Count
bags mixed vs raw DSD vs raw DIST"]:::calc OV["Oven_Info pans to set out"]:::lookup F29["MCS F29 pan list"]:::output E4["E4 typed start time"]:::input MSO --> S1 S1 --> MB MB --> S2 S1 --> S2 UD --> S2 S2 --> S3 UD --> S3 S3 --> S4 S4 --> CO CO --> MCS S4 --> IL IL --> BL CLI --> ATT ATT --> MCS ATT --> BL MCS --> BC BL --> BC OV --> F29 E4 -.->|"printed only"| MCS
